title: Adding Jobs to your tracker - Job Tracker
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Are you tired of losing track of all the jobs you're interested in? In today's video, we break down the easiest ways to get jobs into your job tracker!  Whether you're actively applying or just exploring, having an organized job tracker is essential to a successful job search. Let's dive in!

What We Will Cover:
- How to use the Chrome extension for job tracking
- Adding jobs automatically from job boards like LinkedIn
- Manually adding jobs to your tracker
- Managing your bookmarked jobs 
- Tips for rating jobs and preparing your applications 

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How do I add jobs to my tracker using the Chrome extension?
- Can I manually input jobs into my job tracker?
- What job details does the tracker pull automatically? 
- How can I rate the jobs I'm interested in? 
- What to do if the extension isn’t working on certain sites?
